scientific_role: low-energy causal attribution diagnostic; not C1/C2 revision
c1_policy: all six fitted C1 coefficients frozen exactly

CHI_N2_RESIDUAL.bound_basis: closed empirical envelope of leave-one-point residual-projection amplitudes

PHI_N3_RESIDUAL.bound_basis: closed empirical envelope of leave-one-point residual-projection amplitudes on the six observed low-energy cells

phase_policy: fixed from a*cos(n*theta)+b*sin(n*theta) = R*cos(n*theta-phase), R=hypot(a,b), phase=atan2(b,a)

objective.C3A_CHI_N2: mean squared relaxed-profile residual over observed CHI points with QM relative energy <=10 kcal/mol
objective.C3B_PHI_N3: mean squared relaxed-profile residual over observed PHI points with QM relative energy <=10 kcal/mol
objective.C3C_CHI_N2_PHI_N3: equal mean of CHI<=10 and observed PHI<=10 mean squared relaxed-profile residuals
objective.regularization: none; amplitude is constrained to the preregistered LOO envelope

diagnostic_support_rule.tolerance_provenance: accepted C2 relaxed-profile deterministic replay tolerance
diagnostic_support_rule.C3A: CHI<=10 RMSE improves by > tolerance and PHI/PSI<=10 do not worsen by > tolerance
diagnostic_support_rule.C3B: observed PHI<=10 RMSE improves by > tolerance, every frozen-fit LOO evaluation improves directionally, and CHI/PSI<=10 do not worsen by > tolerance
diagnostic_support_rule.C3C: both CHI<=10 and observed PHI<=10 improve by > tolerance and PSI<=10 does not worsen by > tolerance
